experiments.question: Does adding timeZone to profile-api@v2 meet the additive-only condition (the pre-touch fixtures still validate against the changed schema), what would a required field cost, and is the chosen value pattern tight enough?
experiments.finding: All five fixtures as they stood at de2e86a validate against the schema with an optional timeZone, and the live schema equals that candidate; the same field made required rejects the pre-touch me-ayu and me-budi. The new me-ayu and me-budi fail the pre-touch schema, so the shipped producer's replay fails until it serves timeZone. Both zones match PRD v2 Demo accounts, resolve in Intl to their own names and are booking-api@v1's room zones; the pattern rejects a number, null, an offset, a bare city, an abbreviation and an empty string (Node.js 24.18, tz 2026b, Ajv2020 strict as the backend's replay rig).
